Account: `os-bill`
Seat: `repo:objectstack#5`
Branch: `claude/issue-35645-random-uuid-fallback`
Domain: `domain:ui`
File surface: one shared id helper (falls back when `crypto.randomUUID` is absent, the guarded shape of `newConditionId`) placed in a package the call sites already depend on, plus its export. The one-line call-site swaps at the 26 unguarded `crypto.randomUUID` calls in `ui/packages/*/src` on `origin/main`: `plugin-list` `ListView.tsx` (4); `components` `custom/sort-builder.tsx` (3) and `custom/filter-builder.tsx` (1); `app-shell` `RecordDetailView.tsx` (2), `viewFilterFold.ts` (1) and `ScriptCapabilitiesField.tsx` (1); `core` `actions/TransactionManager.ts` (2); `plugin-chatbot` `utils.ts` (3); `plugin-view` `config/view-config-utils.ts` (3) and `SharedViewLink.tsx` (3); `types` `complex.ts` (1) and `zod/complex.zod.ts` (1). Also their tests and a changeset. ⛔ No `packages/spec/**`, no new cross-package dependency edge, and no change to the logic around a call site. Stop and report on any breach.
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Premise: holds on `origin/main`. The listed sites call `crypto.randomUUID()` bare, which throws in a non-secure context (plain http off localhost). `conditionModel.ts` `newConditionId` already guards it.
Serial constraints cleared: none blocking. Open PRs #35991 (`filter-builder.tsx`, `ListView.tsx`), #35918 (`ListView.tsx`) and #35977 / #35983 / #35984 (`RecordDetailView.tsx`) touch the same files. The swaps here are single-expression edits at the call lines, so whichever lands later merges `main`.
Pre-claim deps: parent #35549 closed (not an epic).
Prior rulings read: card thread → triage only (p2, p1 if a self-hosted intranet http customer reports it).
Review path: L1-a. Approver handoff if Tier H or over 3,000 lines.
